characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
characters.summary: Thestrals are winged skeletal horses visible only to those who have witnessed death. They possess exceptional tracking senses, acute directional awareness, and are capable of swift flight.

techniques: Kicking and biting with sharp teeth and hooves

mechanisms: Invisibility to those who have never witnessed death
Sturdy skeletal hide capable of flight and enduring physical impacts

weaknesses: Vulnerable to standard physical damage if seen or caught
limitations: Only visible to individuals who have witnessed and processed death

sources.supports: General description, abilities, invisibility to non-witnesses of death, and flight capabilities

feats.claim: Flew Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, Ron Weasley, Neville Longbottom, Ginny Weasley, and Luna Lovegood from Hogwarts to the Ministry of Magic.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

campaignTags.claim: Possesses large bat-like wings allowing it to fly long distances carrying passengers.
Can be ridden by humans for aerial transportation during battle and travel.

unknowns: Exact top speed and endurance limits in flight are not fully quantified.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
characters.summary: Frank the Thunderbird is a massive magical avian creature capable of sensing danger and creating powerful storms and lightning with its wings. It possesses immense physical durability and high-speed flight.

techniques: Lightning strike creation with wing power

mechanisms: High durability against magical and physical environments

weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized magical containment or capture by skilled wizards
limitations: Native to Arizona, sensitive to unfamiliar captive environments

sources.supports: Abilities related to storm-making, lightning, and native habitat

feats.claim: Created a massive storm over New York City to help disperse a global obliviating potion across the city.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (film)

campaignTags.claim: Possesses massive wings capable of sustained flight and creating meteorological disturbances.
Generates powerful storms and electrical lightning strikes.

unknowns: Full offensive combat repertoire against skilled duelists remains unobserved.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
characters.summary: Tina Goldstein is an experienced MACUSA Auror skilled in defensive magic, wandless or rapid spellcasting, and investigative techniques. She specializes in tactical restraint rather than raw destruction.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical attacks if caught off guard without her wand
limitations: Relies entirely on her wand for offensive and defensive magic

sources.supports: Background as a MACUSA Auror, spellcasting abilities, and combat style

feats.claim: Participated in neutralizing MACUSA threats and assisted in subduing Credence Barebone alongside other Aurors.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (film)

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (film)
notableResults.note: Fought alongside other MACUSA officials to contain the Obscurus.

campaignTags.claim: Trained witch capable of casting complex combat and utility spells.
Capable of Apparition for instantaneous movement.

unknowns: Full proficiency in advanced dueling outside of MACUSA standard procedures.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
characters.summary: Viktor Krum is a world-class Quidditch Seeker and a formidable duelist representing Durmstrang. He is physically robust, highly competitive, and skilled in dark and practical combat magic.

mechanisms: Exceptional physical reflexes honed by professional Quidditch

weaknesses: Susceptible to psychological manipulation regarding his friends or competitors
limitations: Standard human physical and magical limits without a wand

sources.supports: Durmstrang training, Triwizard Tournament feats, and dueling capabilities

feats.claim: Successfully captured the Golden Egg in the First Task of the Triwizard Tournament while battling a Chinese Horntail.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Performed the Wronski Feint during the Quidditch World Cup.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
notableResults.note: Retrieved the golden egg using tactical flying and transfiguration.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient in advanced combat and transfiguration magic as a Triwizard Champion.
Master broomstick flyer capable of high-speed aerial maneuvers.

unknowns: Extent of his mastery over advanced dark arts taught at Durmstrang outside general school knowledge.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
characters.summary: Vincent Crabbe is a Slytherin student known for brute physical intimidation and proficiency in dark, destructive magic learned late in his schooling, notably including Fiendfyre.
weaknesses: Low tactical intelligence, poor control over advanced magic leading to self-destruction
limitations: Fiendfyre is uncontrollable once summoned and can destroy the caster if not mastered

sources.supports: Slytherin background, use of Fiendfyre, and physical traits

feats.claim: Cast Fiendfyre inside the Room of Requirement, destroying items and eventually consuming himself due to lack of control.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated in the Room of Requirement when his own Fiendfyre consumed him.

campaignTags.claim: Able to cast powerful and dangerous dark curses like Fiendfyre.
Summons sentient, uncontrollable magical fire capable of consuming entire rooms.

unknowns: Limited spell repertoire outside of brute force hexes and Fiendfyre.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
characters.summary: Winky is a house-elf possessing potent innate magic independent of a human wand, allowing her to bypass standard security charms and teleport effortlessly.

mechanisms: Innate house-elf Apparition that bypasses anti-disapparition charms

weaknesses: Bound by house-elf servitude laws, prone to severe emotional distress and despair
limitations: Typically requires orders from a master unless freed, though deep psychological conditioning remains

sources.supports: House-elf magic capabilities, servitude background, and Apparition feats

feats.claim: Transported Barty Crouch Jr. out of the Quidditch World Cup tent under an Invisibility Cloak using house-elf magic.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

campaignTags.claim: Can Apparition-travel anywhere without needing a wand or respecting standard anti-disapparition wards.

unknowns: Combat capabilities in direct offensive dueling against trained wizards are untested.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
characters.summary: Yusuf Kama is a French-Senegalese wizard of pure-blood descent bound by an Unbreakable Vow. He is a skilled duelist specializing in precise wandwork and stealth maneuvers.
weaknesses: Bound by a fatal Unbreakable Vow regarding his mission against Credence Barebone
limitations: Prone to physical debilitation from the eye parasite curse tied to his Vow

sources.supports: Wandwork, background as a pure-blood wizard, and involvement with Grindelwald's faction

feats.claim: Infiltrated the French Ministry of Magic and tracked down Newt Scamander and his allies.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

campaignTags.claim: Skilled wizard capable of complex spellcasting and tracking.
Utilizes Apparition for travel and combat positioning.

unknowns: Full extent of his magical power outside his vendetta against the Lestrange family.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
characters.summary: The Zouwu is a massive, elephant-sized feline magical beast from Chinese mythology. It possesses immense physical strength, incredible speed, multiple tails, and the ability to travel vast distances instantly.

mechanisms: Thick, durable hide resistant to standard low-level hexes

weaknesses: Can be calmed and pacified using magical creature toys like a Knockturn Alley rattle
limitations: Requires pacification or taming by skilled magizoologists to prevent rampages

sources.supports: Size, physical strength, speed, and magical beast traits

feats.claim: Traveled thousands of miles across continents in a remarkably short time and demolished barriers when escaping Circus Arcanus.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

campaignTags.claim: Elephant-sized magical beast with towering height and immense mass.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of its long-distance instantaneous travel beyond mystical beast lore.
